comparison.objective: Press a power cord progressively into a curved cable channel; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Cord task tests deformable routing, sequential pressing, shape following, and seating verification; candidate is a rigid-mechanism tool-use and commissioning task.
comparison.success_condition: All eight cord sections must lie below the channel lip without moving the fixture or pulling out the cord; candidate requires two safe dynamic stops and no lock drift.
comparison.reason: Deformable cable routing is meaningfully different from rigid damper adjustment. Missing rubric details: no cord-force or damage threshold is stated.
